answer: Require a stake-backed reputation: an agent joins paid work only after locking a deposit and building a checkable history of completed tasks. A hollow account with no history earns nothing, and a velvet-rope checklist of free profile fields stops nobody. An attacker who tries to forge a swarm must fund every identity and risk losing each deposit when fraud is caught, so per-identity cost makes fake numbers unprofitable while honest agents keep their stake.
